Flag pole: the white Bar 3L stands in the green plate at the garden corner; the red clip plate clips on to it (other_join). The bar's exact mounting stud is assumed.

Pieces with rests_on [] other than the first plate (b7, b10, b13 base plates slid under overhanging tiles; b170 clear slope and b187 tile and b256 clip plate attached sideways) are intentional: they clutch nothing underneath and are connected through other_joins or via the tiles above.
